correctness.rationale: Both exhaustive direct enumeration and independently structured maximum-insertion enumeration return exactly 4541 allowed eight-position permutations. Fixed-query support recursion exhausts all potential shattered sets and proves VC=6; a six-query witness realizes 64 patterns. An independently replayed complete depth-eleven adaptive tree has 2047 internal nodes and 2048 distinct satisfying leaf permutations. Exhaustive version-space recurrence rejects depth twelve, after 77182 cached states, not a timeout. The general direct-sum lower bound and forest-based VC upper bound are proved without extrapolating finite experiments.

value.rationale: The two-descent Eulerian subclass is a canonical rank-restricted family of linear orders. At eight positions it simultaneously first loses full-permutation static forest capacity and the concept-count adaptive ceiling, yielding a natural exact finite threshold. The depth-eleven certificate gives a rigorously amplified unbounded VC/Littlestone gap for a proportional descent budget, a meaningful structural consequence beyond enumerating one table entry.
